agent_instructions.proposition: For current stable HTTP server spans, use span kind `SERVER`.
Record `http.request.method`, `url.path`, and `url.scheme`, and add `http.response.status_code` if and only if a response status was sent.

supported_by.quote: http.request.method Required string HTTP request method.
url.path Required string The URI path component
url.scheme Required string The URI scheme component
http.response.status_code Conditionally Required If and only if one was received/sent.

agent_instructions.proposition: Use `http.route` for an available matched route template; it must remain low-cardinality, and a URI path cannot substitute for it.

supported_by.quote: http.route Conditionally Required If and only if it’s available
the URI path can NOT substitute it

agent_instructions.proposition: The route is conditionally required only when it is available.

supported_by.quote: http.route Conditionally Required If and only if it’s available

agent_instructions.proposition: Use `server.address` for the logical server host.

supported_by.quote: server.address Recommended string Name of the local HTTP server

agent_instructions.proposition: Do not substitute the historical `http.method`, `http.status_code`, `http.target`, `http.scheme`, or `net.host.name` names for these current attributes.
